title: ChatPlanner: A Large Language Model Framework for Personalized Public Transit Routing
abstract: arXiv:2606.15315v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Personalized public transit routing in public transit systems remains challenging due to the difficulty of capturing and integrating diverse user preferences into routing algorithms. This paper presents ChatPlanner, a novel framework that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to enable preference-aware public transit routing. Our approach employs fine-tuned LLMs with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to extract routing parameters and interpret conversationally expressed preferences from natural language queries as preference scores, subsequently integrating these preferences into the objective function of a public transit routing algorithm. This study designs preference-aware datasets incorporating eight personas and five contexts to establish scoring standards for both fine-tuning and RAG. This work conducted four experiments to validate the solutions' feasibility, extraction of routing information and preferences, solution set

translated_title: ChatPlanner：一个用于个性化公共交通路线规划的大语言模型框架
translated_abstract: 摘要：在公共交通系统中，个性化公共交通路线规划仍然具有挑战性，因为难以捕捉和整合多样化的用户偏好到路线规划算法中。本文介绍了ChatPlanner，一种新颖的框架，利用大语言模型（LLMs）实现偏好感知的公共交通路线规划。我们的方法采用微调的大语言模型结合检索增强生成（RAG），从自然语言查询中提取路线规划参数，并将对话式表达的用户偏好解释为偏好分数，随后将这些偏好整合到公共交通路线规划算法的目标函数中。本研究设计了包含八种人物角色和五种情境的偏好感知数据集，以建立微调和RAG的评分标准。本研究进行了四项实验，以验证解决方案的可行性、路线信息和偏好的提取，以及解决方案集。
tldr: 本文提出ChatPlanner框架，利用微调的大语言模型与检索增强生成技术，将自然语言中的用户偏好转化为评分并整合到公共交通路线规划算法中，实现个性化路线规划。
en_tdlr: This paper presents ChatPlanner, a framework that uses fine-tuned LLMs with RAG to extract user preferences from natural language and integrate them into public transit routing algorithms for personalized route planning.
